tools.name: CodexReview
tools.description: Runs a real Codex review (OpenAI Codex via the codex plugin's companion, read-only) of the git branch checked out in `cwd` against `base`, and returns Codex's findings as JSON: verdict, summary, findings[severity,title,body,file,line_start,line_end,confidence,recommendation], next_steps. Takes minutes. If it fails it returns an error: never substitute your own review for it.
